svg.title: First-parent counting is fragile; all-parent counting is not
svg.desc: An older common ancestor O forks into main commits C1 through C4 and unmerged feature commits F1 and F2; main points to C4 with a count of 4. After main is merged into feature and main fast-forwards to merge M, M's first parent is F2 and its second parent is C4. A first-parent position count reaches only M, F2, and F1, so it decreases from 4 to 3. The all-parent date cohort holds all seven same-date commits reachable from M, so N increases from 4 to 7.

g.text: NEXT: MERGE MAIN INTO FEATURE, THEN FAST-FORWARD MAIN TO M
